stepNotes.1: Three production surfaces were traced: external registry discovery and its Express route, scheduled-task JSON normalization/persistence, and deterministic project-ID creation; feature-routes-runtime.js and server/index.js establish their live composition points.
stepNotes.2: Local agent registries supply absolute paths and metadata, while project JSON stores prompts, schedules, provider/model choices, and execution state; absolute-path checks and the project-ID filename allowlist bound the two filesystem-facing trust edges.
stepNotes.3: Schedule/date/timezone/task invariants are enforced, but the 240-character Codex trust scan crosses section boundaries and the server project-ID helper does not canonicalize Windows drive case like the UI helper, producing reproducible identity drift.
stepNotes.4: Promise-chain locks serialize each project's mutations and temp-file rename supplies atomic replacement; discovery remains linearly latency-bound because every candidate stat is awaited serially, acceptable for small interactive registries.
stepNotes.5: Registry parsing, route adaptation, config normalization, and scheduled execution have sensible ownership, while duplicate server/UI implementations of path identity are a concrete design seam whose normalization contracts have diverged.
stepNotes.6: The empty catch at project-config.js:352 silently removes invalid persisted tasks from reads and a later write can make that removal permanent; JSON, cron, ENOENT, and registry-read catches elsewhere have explicit sentinel or propagation behavior.
stepNotes.7: Focused Vitest execution passed 2 files and 13 tests; coverage is strong for persistence, merging, sorting, bounds, cron, timestamps, and once schedules but absent for project-id.js, section-bounded TOML trust, invalid-task preservation, and concurrent mutations.
stepNotes.8: The existing Low deferred empty-catch finding was confirmed; this pass additionally records a Medium candidate for cross-platform ID drift and a Low trust-metadata parsing defect, with no Critical item requiring reverify.md.
stepNotes.9: The authoritative web-package Vitest command completed successfully, manual read-only probes reproduced the two new observations, and the review closed without changing production code, the existing ledger, or another audit unit.
